title: WILSON US Open Team Tennis Racket Bag
writeup: Wilson's US Open Team racket bag holds up to three rackets and carries the 2024 US Open look with the yellow zipper lining. Woot has it new for $24.99. Lifestyles Sports lists the same bag (UPC 097512832809, MPN WR8035901, White-001) at $58.99 in stock. Only three left on Woot with a three-per-customer limit, so it will not last.
